legal.terms_subtitle: Transparent rules of conduct and usage for {{appName}}.
legal.privacy_subtitle: How we protect your personal data under LGPD and Brazil's Marco Civil da Internet.
legal.consent_prefix: I declare that I am 18 or older and accept the
legal.terms_required: You must accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
legal.settings_desc: Review the platform's legal documents and your recorded consent.
legal.terms_age_body: Access to {{appName}} is strictly restricted to individuals aged 18 or older. Birth date verification is mandatory during both standard registration and Google OAuth onboarding.
legal.terms_feed_body: Your Following timeline presents posts in transparent chronological order without hidden algorithmic manipulation or invasive behavioral tracking.
legal.terms_conduct_body: Illegal content, harassment, spam, and third-party rights violations are prohibited. You have active controls for bilateral blocking (mutual invisibility), asymmetric muting, private accounts, and hiding replies on your posts.
legal.terms_ip_body: You retain full ownership of the content you publish, granting the platform only a limited technical license to display it according to your chosen visibility (Public or Close Friends).
legal.terms_termination_body: You may permanently delete your account at any time under Settings > Account, ending your relationship with immediate effect.
legal.privacy_data_body: We collect only the data strictly needed for authentication and platform operation: email, username, birth date (18+ gate), profile details, posts, drafts, comments, and theme/language/notification preferences. We never sell your data.
legal.privacy_controls_body: You control who sees your profile and posts via Private Account, Close Friends, likes tab visibility, muting, and bilateral blocking (which hides profiles, posts, comments, search results, and mentions in both directions).
legal.privacy_retention_body: In compliance with Art. 15 of Brazilian Law No. 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet), minimal access logs are retained for 6 months with IP addresses protected via irreversible cryptographic hashing (HMAC-SHA256).
legal.privacy_lgpd_body: Under Art. 18 of LGPD, you may export a complete JSON copy of your data or request permanent, irreversible account deletion (atomic hard-delete with comment anonymization in threads) directly in Settings > Account.
